## Map: Personality Model (BigFive/OCEAN+H + Enneagram) — engine state and all read-sites

**TL;DR:** `bigFive` is a flat, 6-field, immutable struct living on `AgentProfile` (static world-data), read directly as plain numbers at ~17 sites. It is NEVER serialized — `World.toJSON()` saves only `agent.state`, so the profile is re-sourced from world JSON every boot. Mood, by contrast, already uses the deformation machinery (`baseMood + Σ modifiers`) the spec wants to unify with. Enneagram stress/growth is a temporary, prose-only mood->directive map that mutates no state.

**Architecture:**
- `BigFive` interface — `agent-types.ts:1-8`: 6 fields (O,C,E,A,N + honesty/H). Lives on `AgentProfile.bigFive` (`agent-types.ts:92`). Profile = static, immutable world-data.
- `Enneagram` interface — `agent-types.ts:72-80`: type/wing/coreFear/coreDesire/stressType/growthType. Drives WHY-prose, not utility math.
- `OceanHTrait` union + `AffordanceWeight` — `al.ts:30-38`: closed 6-letter trait code; affordance weights reference it.
- `ScalarAttribute` + `driftAttribute` — `attributes.ts:26-91`: the REUSE target. base + clamp(min,max) + decaying modifiers + optional base-drift. Already generalizes the MoodModifier pattern. baseMood + moodModifiers (`world.ts:547-550`) is the same physics for mood.

**Data flow (trait -> behavior):**
1. Boot: world JSON `personality.{O,C,E,A,N,H}` -> `profile.bigFive` (`world-loader.ts:223-236`). Optionally perturbed once by `trait-randomizer.ts:86` (`profile.bigFive[prop] = ...`).
2. Decision: `computeUtility` (`al.ts:447`) loops `aff.weights`, reads `agent.profile.bigFive[TRAIT_MAP[w.trait]]` (`al.ts:451`, TRAIT_MAP `al.ts:391-394`), `effective = direction==='high' ? v : 1-v`. moodCurve takes `bigFive.honesty` to shift crime zones (`al.ts:457`, curve `al.ts:403-417`).
3. Prose: `bigFiveToDescription` (`personality-prose.ts:4-19`, 6 hardcoded thresholds) -> volition system prompt (`volition.ts:389`), reflection (`agent.ts:269`), descriptions (`agent.ts:408/524`).
4. Instinct resistance: `getResistanceVoice` (`instinct-builder.ts:197-223`) reads `bigFive[rt.trait]` by full key, driven by `resistTraits` from affordance (`volition.ts:465` -> `instinct-builder.ts:268-270`).
5. Stress/growth (TEMPORARY): `getStressGrowthDirective(mood, enn)` (`personality-prose.ts:46-50`) — `mood<-0.5 -> STRESS_DESC[stressType]`, `mood>0.3 -> GROWTH_DESC[growthType]`. Pure string; mutates nothing; consumed in `volition.ts:401`.
6. Derivations: baseMood from N/E (`world.ts:1988` load fallback; formula in `agent-types.ts:149`); social-stress drift target from N/A/H (`world.ts:537`); loneliness rate from E (`world.ts:578`).
7. CG / module / UI reads: `cg-engine.checkTrait` (`cg-engine.ts:344`, casts to `Record<string,number>`, indexes by arbitrary string); il.ts:626-627; crime-justice many sites; `routes.ts:118/801/819` -> client `game.js:1919`.

**Key decisions / patterns:**
1. Profile is static, state is dynamic — only `agent.state` is in `toJSON()` (`world.ts:1882-1902`); `profile`/`bigFive` excluded (`world.ts:89-114` `WorldSaveAgentData` has no profile fields). Trait values are re-derived from world JSON each boot. (`world-loader.ts:223-236`)
2. Mood already IS the deformation model the spec describes — `effectiveMood = baseMood + Σ modifierEffective(m)`, never directly mutated (INV-06). `ScalarAttribute` (`attributes.ts`) is the explicit generalization (base + clamp + decaying modifiers + base-drift). Unifying personality means: traits become per-axis ScalarAttribute-like state ON AgentState, read via an effective() accessor. (`attributes.ts:26-91`, `world.ts:547-550`)
3. Trait axis set is closed in FOUR places that must all open together: `BigFive` (`agent-types.ts:1-8`), `OceanHTrait`+`TRAIT_MAP` (`al.ts:30,391-394`), `BigFiveTraits` (`instinct-builder.ts:38-45`), `AffordanceWeight.trait`/`resistTraits` unions (`al.ts:33,134`).
4. Enneagram stress/growth is the existing TEMPORARY behavioral shift — elastic, prose-only, gated on mood band. It is orthogonal to plasticity (permanent baseline set): plasticity would change baseMood / an axis, which then changes which Enneagram band mood lands in — a seam, not the same mechanism. (`personality-prose.ts:46-50`)

**What EXACTLY breaks if traits become mutable + axis set opens:**
- **Save/load silently loses every shift.** `bigFive` is on profile, not serialized (`world.ts:1882-1902`); reload resets to world-JSON (`world-loader.ts:223-236`). Any runtime mutation of `profile.bigFive` is wiped each boot. Plastic state MUST live on `AgentState` (like baseMood/attributes, which ARE saved at `world.ts:1890-1892`) to satisfy INV-21. Mutating profile directly = data loss.
- **Split-brain reads.** ~17 sites read `agent.profile.bigFive.X` as a flat number directly (al.ts:451, instinct-builder.ts:205, cg-engine.ts:344, world.ts:537/578/1988, topic-engine.ts:238-239, scheduler.ts:133-134, social/topic-sources.ts:664, + all crime-justice/il module sites). Converting to base+modifiers means every site must call an effective() accessor; any site left on the raw base reads the un-deformed value while others read the deformed one.
- **Closed unions reject new axes.** A module axis (e.g. stability/wound) is unreachable by `computeUtility` weights and `resistTraits` until `OceanHTrait`/`AffordanceWeight.trait`/`BigFiveTraits`/`resistTraits` become open string keys. `bigFiveToDescription` (`personality-prose.ts:4-19`) hardcodes exactly 6 trait prose blocks — new axes produce no prose unless registry-driven.
- **Only `cg-engine.ts:344` survives unchanged** — it already casts to `Record<string,number>` and returns false for unknown traits (line 345). It is the de-facto open reader today (and a latent typing smell worth noting, not fixing).
- **Derived couplings won't auto-update.** baseMood (`world.ts:1988`) and social-stress target (`world.ts:537`) read trait base at fixed moments; if N/E/A/H deform, these need explicit re-derivation paths, not passive reads. baseMood is itself a deformable scalar, so plastic-N -> baseMood-shift is a chained deformation needing a recompute hook.
- **Client contract shifts.** `routes.ts:118/801/819` ship `agent.profile.bigFive` verbatim; `game.js:1919/1971` render `data.bigFive`. An open/mutable axis set changes the serialized shape the frontend consumes.

**Referenced answers:**
- Q: Where + how are Enneagram stress/growth shifts applied? / A: `personality-prose.ts:46-50` `getStressGrowthDirective(mood, enn)` — mood<-0.5 emits `STRESS_DESC[enn.stressType]`, mood>0.3 emits `GROWTH_DESC[enn.growthType]` (tables `personality-prose.ts:21-43`). Output is a directive STRING appended to the volition system prompt (`volition.ts:401`). It mutates no state and does not touch utility scores — purely temporary, mood-band-gated, elastic.
- Q: Every bigFive read-site? / A: engine: al.ts:451,457; instinct-builder.ts:205; personality-prose.ts:4-19; volition.ts:385-389; cg-engine.ts:344; world.ts:536-537,578,1988; topic-engine.ts:238-239; scheduler.ts:133-134; agent.ts:267-269. modules: social/topic-sources.ts:664; crime-justice/index.ts:672-691,853,1189-1190,1283-1284; investigation.ts:243-244; step-handlers.ts:91,112,178; il.ts:626-627. server/UI: world-loader.ts:229; trait-randomizer.ts:86,106-162,308; routes.ts:118,654,801,819; index.ts:301,519; game.js:1919,1971.

**Not explored:** trait-randomizer constraint-clamp logic beyond the mutation point; full crime-justice scoring formulas (mapped as read-sites only, not traced); affordance-space modifier / SPEC-2 surface (out of this slice's PM focus).

## Map: Mood-modifier machinery (the ELASTIC model)

**TL;DR:** Mood is a pure DERIVED scalar: `effectiveMood = clamp(baseMood + Σ modifierEffective(m), -1, 1)`, recomputed every tick. `baseMood` is the spring's rest position; `moodModifiers[]` are timed, decaying displacements that spring back to zero (elastic). INV-06 forbids writing `mood` directly — the only legal write is `addModifier()`, and the tick overwrites `mood` from base+modifiers. The scalar-attribute subsystem (`attributes.ts`) ALREADY generalizes this exact pattern to open string keys with a plastic base + elastic modifiers + optional base-drift — it is the ready-made template a trait axis would extend.

**Architecture (elastic model):**
- `MoodModifier` shape — `world-types.ts:6-14`: `{id, source, category, magnitude, remaining, duration, decay}`. `remaining=duration=0` ⇒ permanent. `category` = stacking group.
- `modifierEffective(m)` — `world-types.ts:17-22`: decay curve. `none`/`duration=0` → full magnitude; `linear` → `magnitude × (remaining/duration)`; `exponential` → `magnitude × ratio²`. **A byte-identical private copy lives at `attributes.ts:38-43`.**
- `AgentState.baseMood` / `mood` / `moodModifiers` — `agent-types.ts:147-152`. Comment is explicit: `mood` is "computed effectiveMood from baseMood + modifiers".
- `addModifier(npcId, mod)` — `world.ts:611-637`: the sole write API. NaN/Inf guard (614-618), per-category stacking cap (`maxPerCategory`, default 3) evicting the weakest non-permanent (629-634), assigns `crypto.randomUUID()`, pushes.
- `_upsertPermanent(mods, category, mag, source?)` — `world.ts:640-648`: singleton permanent modifier keyed by category (id=category, duration=0). Used for `social_stress` and `loneliness`.
- `removeModifiers(npcId, category)` — `world.ts:651-655`.

**Data flow (per tick, 5 game-min step):**
```
_tickMoodSystem() [world.ts:556]  — bilateral over alive, non-absent agents (INV-16)
  → _computeMoodTick(agent,cfg) [508]
       1. decay: each mod.remaining -= 5; splice if ≤0; NaN guard  [515-523]
       2. social_stress drift toward personality-scaled target (_upsertPermanent) [525-545]
       3. agent.state.mood = clamp(baseMood + Σ modifierEffective, -1,1)  [547-550]  ← ELASTIC SUM
  → loneliness permanent modifier (real-tick only) [571-580], recompute sum [582-587]
  → scalar-attribute decay+drift (real-tick only): decayAttribute/driftAttribute(attr,5) [591-593]
  → onMoodChange callback if |Δ|>0.0005 [595-597]  → WS broadcast
  → mood-history snapshot (cap MOOD_HISTORY_MAX) [599-603]
```
Inputs arrive ONLY through `addModifier` (conversations world.ts:1088/1093, goals 1248, death 1685, IL pressure, module hooks via `callbacks.addMoodModifier`). `_computeMoodTick` is intentionally side-effect-free (shared with calibration helper `advanceMoodMath`, world.ts:806) — conserved-state decay deliberately excluded (world.ts:551-553).

**How a trait axis reuses this EXACTLY (elastic modifier + plastic baseline):**
The scalar-attribute subsystem (`attributes.ts`) is the mood pattern already generalized to an OPEN registry — this is the reuse target:
- ELASTIC layer = `AttributeModifier` (`attributes.ts:11-23`, structurally identical to MoodModifier) on `ScalarAttribute.modifiers[]`, applied via `attributeEffective = clamp(base + Σ modifierEffective, min, max)` (`attributes.ts:54-58`) and ticked by `decayAttribute(attr,dt)` (`attributes.ts:61-69`). A temporary trait nudge (Enneagram stress/growth-style, but quantified) is exactly an `AttributeModifier` added via `addAttributeModifier()` (`world.ts:685`).
- PLASTIC layer = a permanent change to `ScalarAttribute.base`, done via `adjustAttributeBase(npcId,key,delta)` (`world.ts:674-682`, clamped). This is the "permanent set" — the analog of shifting `baseMood` rather than adding a transient modifier.
- BASE DRIFT (optional annealing) = `driftAttribute` (`attributes.ts:76-91`): base moves linearly or exponentially toward a target each tick — a ready-made mechanism for slow reversibility.

So a trait axis = one `ScalarAttribute` per open trait key: `base` = plastic disposition (re-set by lived experience / self-action), `modifiers[]` = elastic temporary shifts that spring back, `effective = clamp(base + Σ decayed modifiers)`. The SAME `_tickMoodSystem` loop that already calls `decayAttribute`/`driftAttribute` at `world.ts:591-593` would tick trait axes with zero new tick plumbing.

**Key facts / patterns:**
1. mood = derived, single-writer (INV-06) — `world.ts:550`. The whole elastic model exists so disposition springs back to a baseline each tick.
2. Two parallel-but-separate primitives today: bounded mood ([-1,1], no open keys, no base-drift) vs. open ScalarAttribute (arbitrary key/range + drift). Trait axes map onto the ScalarAttribute generalization, not onto mood's fixed shape.
3. `baseMood` itself is derived from static `bigFive` on load when absent (`world.ts:1988`: `0.3 - N×0.4 + E×0.2`) — already demonstrates "personality seeds a baseline" but the personality source is the IMMUTABLE profile.
4. Trait READS bypass state entirely: `computeUtility` reads `agent.profile.bigFive[TRAIT_MAP[trait]]` (`al.ts:451`), as do ~17 sites. A plastic baseline that does not flow through these reads is behaviorally inert.
5. Persistence already round-trips elastic+plastic state with INV-21 defaults and SL-07 NaN filtering for mood AND attributes (`world.ts:1882-1902`, `1987-2005`) — the discipline to copy for any new plastic trait field.

**Gotchas:**
- 5-min tick step is hardcoded in three places (`world.ts:522`, `592`); all durations/rates are calibrated to it.
- `_computeMoodTick` vs `_tickMoodSystem` split (calibration-safe vs real-tick): put trait DECAY in the real-tick path only, mirroring scalar attributes (`world.ts:591-593`), or risk double-decay during `advanceMoodMath`.
- Stacking eviction counts only `duration>0` modifiers (`world.ts:629`); permanent shifts use `_upsertPermanent`/`adjustAttributeBase`, a different code path — don't conflate a plastic baseline with a stacking modifier.
- `bigFive` on `AgentProfile` is the single biggest seam: making a trait baseline plastic means either relocating it into `AgentState` or shimming all ~17 direct reads. `cg-engine.ts:344` even casts `profile.bigFive` to `Record<string,number>` — an OPEN-axis read pattern already half-present.

**Not explored (outside this focus slice):** Affordance-space modifier / AL possible-set (SPEC 2), belief/relationship magnitude seams, Enneagram stress/growth prose (personality-prose.ts / agent.ts:531 buildStressGrowthDirective) beyond noting it as the existing TEMPORARY-shift mechanism, event-registry hook surface details.

This is the central blast radius.

## Map: Scalar Attributes B1 — generalized quantified-state primitive

**Допущения:** depth=medium→deep по запросу; прочитан весь `attributes.ts`, World API, tick-loop, save/load, оба модульных потребителя (economy), тесты, и read-sites BigFive. Не разворачивал: CG-движок целиком, beliefs/relationships internals (только seams отмечены).

**TL;DR:** B1 — это string-keyed слой числового состояния на `AgentState`: `ScalarAttribute = {base, min, max, modifiers[], drift?}`. Эффективное значение = `clamp(base + Σ decayed-modifiers)`. ДВЕ ортогональные деформации уже физически разделены: модификаторы затухают (ЭЛАСТИЧНО, как mood), а `base` дрейфует через optional `drift` (ПЛАСТИЧНО — цена/голод/регенерация). Движок не присваивает ключам смысла (INV-14); модули (economy) задают значения. Personality plasticity ложится на ЭТУ модель почти буквально — но главный разрыв в том, что `bigFive` сейчас живёт на `AgentProfile` (статично, immutable) и читается напрямую как `agent.profile.bigFive[...]`, а не через attribute-read.

**Architecture:**
- `attributes.ts:11` `AttributeModifier` — таймед/затухающая дельта (id/source/category/magnitude/remaining/duration/decay). ДУБЛИКАТ `MoodModifier` (`world-types.ts:6`) — идентичные поля + идентичный `modifierEffective`.
- `attributes.ts:26` `ScalarAttribute` — `base + [min,max] + modifiers[] + drift?`. `drift?.{ratePerMinute, toward?}` (`:35`): без `toward` — линейный дрейф base; с `toward` — экспоненциальное приближение `1-e^(-rate·dt)`. Отсутствует = нет дрейфа (INV-21).
- Pure-функции: `createAttribute` (`:49`, клампит base), `attributeEffective` (`:54`), `decayAttribute` (`:61`, тикает только modifiers, дропает истёкшие), `driftAttribute` (`:76`, двигает только base, NaN-защита DD-04), `getAttributeValue` (`:94`).
- Carrier: `AgentState.attributes?: Record<string, ScalarAttribute>` (`agent-types.ts:154`) — **только агенты**, zone-носителя нет.

**Data flow:**
```
boot: worldData.startingAttributes → world.setAttribute(npc,key,base,min,max)  (server/index.ts:728)
        ↳ player gold seeded separately (index.ts:738)
module write: economy pricing sets attr.drift={rate,toward}  (pricing.ts:48,74)  ← задаёт только цель
              economy transfers gold via world.transferAttribute  (step-handlers.ts:36)
per tick (dt=5, real-tick only, bilateral): world.ts:591
        for attr of agent.attributes: decayAttribute(attr,5); driftAttribute(attr,5)
                                       └ elastic (modifiers→0)  └ plastic (base→toward)
read (utility): computeUtility #6 channel → SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS → getAttributeValue  (al.ts:486)
read (gate):    CG `attr` op → getAttributeValue, undefined⇒false  (cg-engine.ts:292-295)
save:  toJSON spreads attributes verbatim  (world.ts:1892)
load:  SL-07 — skip non-finite base, re-clamp via createAttribute, filter NaN modifiers,
       preserve drift only if finite  (world.ts:1992-2005)
```

**Key decisions / patterns:**
1. **Две деформации физически разделены** — `decayAttribute` (модификаторы, эластично) и `driftAttribute` (base, пластично) — отдельные функции, вызываемые подряд (`world.ts:592`). Это и есть искомая «одна физика деформации», но реализована как два code-path, НЕ один `deform()`.
2. **drift = опциональный модульный knob** (`attributes.ts:35`, default absent). Это прямой кандидат для plasticity reversibility/«annealing»: нет drift = необратимый сдвиг (дефолт спеки), есть `toward=baseline` = постепенный откат.
3. **Conservation-семантика** в `transferAttribute` (`world.ts:707`): проверка на `base` не `effective`, атомарность, overdraft-guard (`:712`). Спроектировано под gold/HP — для personality бессмысленно.
4. **Полностью genre-neutral read-каналы**: `SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS` (`al.ts:437`) и CG `attr` op (`cg-engine.ts:292`) читают по строковому ключу. Если traits станут attributes — они мгновенно станут scoring-able и CG-gate-able.
5. **economy = доказательство модели**: цена и голод целиком построены на E1-дрейфе (`pricing.ts:5-8`), модуль задаёт только цель/скорость, движок эволюционирует base. Тот же паттерн = личностный сдвиг через событие.

**Gotchas:**
- **BigFive ≠ attribute сегодня.** `bigFive` на `AgentProfile` (`agent-types.ts:92`), читается как `agent.profile.bigFive[TRAIT_MAP[w.trait]]` (`al.ts:451`) с флипом `1-traitValue` для direction='low'. Attributes — на `AgentState`. Чтобы personality «была» ScalarAttribute, все ~17 readers должны перейти с `profile.bigFive` на state-backed `attributeEffective`-read. Это центральный blast radius.
- **Mood ещё НЕ ScalarAttribute.** Mood = `baseMood + moodModifiers` через `_computeMoodTick` (`world.ts:569`), собственный тип `MoodModifier`, собственный `modifierEffective`. Заявка «personality joins the SAME machinery as mood» требует либо миграции mood на ScalarAttribute, либо принятия ДВУХ параллельных decay-движков (сейчас именно дубликаты).
- **Tick перебирает ВСЕ attributes ключ-агностично** (`world.ts:592`). Traits-as-attributes автоматически получат decay+drift каждый тик — это и есть нужная механика, но без drift-конфига trait не аннилится (= необратим, что совпадает с дефолтом спеки).
- **Нет zone-носителя.** `AgentState.attributes` агент-only. SPEC 2 «zone как активный объект с состоянием» не имеет места хранения — модель ScalarAttribute переиспользуема, но carrier для zone не существует.
- **save/load — explicit whitelist** (`world.ts:1892`/`1992` + тип `WorldSaveAgentData:96`). Новое состояние не персистится, пока не тронуты обе функции + тип; INV-21 требует backward-compat default.
- **`SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS` — process-global mutable** (`al.ts:438`), test-only clear (`:445`); тесты обязаны сбрасывать (`attributes.test.ts:20`).

**Referenced answers:**
- **Q: Может ли personality буквально быть scalar attributes, или общая механика за typed-view?** / **A:** Буквально — частично. *Модель данных* (`base+min+max+modifiers+drift`) и *физика* (`attributeEffective`/`decay`/`drift`, `world.ts:592` tick) подходят 1:1: baseMood-аналог = `base`, mood-modifiers-аналог = `modifiers` (эластично), плотический сдвиг = `adjustAttributeBase`/`drift` (пластично), необратимость = absent-drift (INV-21). НО три причины против «traits = просто ещё одни attributes под тем же API»: (1) ~17 readers читают `agent.profile.bigFive` напрямую (`al.ts:451`, `instinct-builder.ts:205`), а не `attributeEffective` — переезд traits на `AgentState` ломает их всех; (2) generic World API экспонирует `transferAttribute`, бессмысленный/опасный для traits; (3) traits нужен open-axis registry (OCEAN+H seeded + module-extra), а `attributes` — плоский `Record<string,…>` без понятия «axis set». **Вывод-карта (без дизайна):** общий *deformation-механизм* (ScalarAttribute math + tick) переиспользуем напрямую; но нужен **typed view/seam** поверх — он (а) хранит traits на state как ScalarAttribute с `min=0,max=1`, (б) даёт читателям effective-read вместо `profile.bigFive`, (в) НЕ наследует conservation/transfer-API, (г) добавляет axis-registry поверх плоской мапы. `attr` op и scoring-channel переиспользуются без изменений.
- **Q: drift как seam к reversibility?** / **A:** Да, `attributes.ts:35` optional `drift` уже точно моделирует «annealing»: `{toward: baseline, ratePerMinute}` = откат, absent = необратимо. Дефолт спеки (irreversible) = просто не задавать drift.

**Not explored (вне карты):**
- CG-движок целиком (только `attr`-op seam, `cg-engine.ts:292`).
- beliefs/relationships internals — спека хочет magnitude-scaling от self-belief/sentiment; помечены как read-seams, но их API не картирован здесь.
- Enneagram stress/growth (`agent-types.ts:78`) — упомянут как существующий temporary-shift механизм для связи с plasticity, но не картирован.
- AL possible-set / REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS / validatePlayerAction (нужны для SPEC 2) — вне фокуса B1.

## Map: Beliefs + Relationships — seams for Personality Plasticity (SPEC1) и Affordance-Space Modifier (SPEC2)

**Допущение:** глубина — medium→deep на двух запрошенных файлах + точки интеграции (al.ts/event-registry.ts/cg-engine.ts/il.ts). Это карта реальности, не дизайн.

**TL;DR:** `beliefs.ts` — плоский `Map<id,Belief>` store с одной точкой записи (`addBelief`) и confidence∈[0,1]; `relationships.ts` — направленный граф sentiment/trust/standing с клампленными мутаторами. Оба уже читаются `computeUtility` (al.ts) как каналы скоринга, и оба уже имеют прецедент «масштабировать величину от trust» (il.ts:532). Чистые seam-формы для обоих SPEC существуют, но «self-belief» — это MODULE-конвенция (`b.subject===self.id`), а не engine-примитив, и self-направленных relationship нет.

---

### Beliefs — что ЕСТЬ

**Shape** (`beliefs.ts:6`): `{id, eventType, subject|null, object|null, location|null, confidence 0..1, source, sourceNpcId|null, gameDay, lastUpdated}`. Нет поля «self»/«about-me».

**API** (`BeliefManager`, `beliefs.ts:41`):
- `addBelief` (44) — единственная запись. Contract guards (id/eventType/source/confidence∈[0,1], кидает иначе). Dedup по `(eventType,object,source)` через `findExisting` (74) — НЕ по id; одинаковый source про одно событие → reinforce (берёт max confidence), разные source → сосуществуют.
- `getMaxConfidenceFor(subject, eventTypeMatcher?)` (82) — точный примитив для «масштабировать величину от self-belief»: вызов с `subject=selfId`.
- `queryBeliefs({eventType,subject,object})` (92), `getStrongestBelief` (120), `getTopBeliefs` (138, confidence×recency).
- `decayBeliefs` (108) — `confidence = max(0.1, conf - sourceRate×eventTypeRate×days)`. Floor 0.1, никогда не 0.

**Source-флаги** (3 раздельных registry в `event-registry.ts`, ключ — строка source):
- константы `BELIEF_SOURCE {TESTIMONY,OBSERVATION,GOSSIP,EVIDENCE}` (332) — engine владеет; modules добавляют свои.
- `registerBeliefSourceLabels` (320, fallback=identity), `registerSourceTransferWeights` (357, fallback 0.6), `registerSourceDecayRates` (371, fallback 0.02), `registerSourceCategory/isSourceCategory` (654, семантические группы guilt/direct_experience).

**Event→belief emission seam** (то, что нужно SPEC1 «shift emits a belief/memory»):
- `registerBeliefCreator(consequenceType, fn)` (605) ← вызывается из `cg-engine.ts:397`: CG резолвит subject/object в ID, потом дёргает module-creator, который пишет `addBelief`. 11 примеров в crime `index.ts:408-555`.
- `registerBeliefPhrasing`/`phraseBelief` (762/766) — genre-neutral NL-фрейминг, first-non-null-wins, нейтральный fallback без «wrongdoing».
- Прецедент engine-emitted belief: `il.ts:539` пишет belief с `source=TESTIMONY`.

### Relationships — что ЕСТЬ

**Shape** (`relationships.ts:5`): `{targetId, targetName, type, sentiment -1..1, trust 0..1, standing? -1..1}`. Направленный (от носителя к target). `getRelationship(self)` → null.

**API** (`RelationshipGraph`, 49): `getRelationship` (64), `adjustSentiment`/`adjustTrust` (72/81, клампят + `onChange`), `adjustStanding` (106, клампит, НЕ `onChange`), `getTestimonyWeight(src)` (91, trust как множитель уверенности, fallback 0.3 для чужих), `getGriefPenalty` (97). `addRelationship` (53) — единственный chokepoint санитизации (SL-07).

---

### Data flow seam (как оба SPEC сцепляются с существующим скорингом)

`computeUtility` (`al.ts:447`) уже агрегирует 6 каналов:
- **sentiment**: `relationshipWeight × sentimentCurve(rel.sentiment)` (461-463) — но только если `rel` существует (для чужих null → 0).
- **trust**: `trustWeight × rel.trust` (482).
- **belief**: `beliefModifiers[].weight × maxConfidence(eventType)` (468-478).
- **module-каналы**: `registerScoringContributor` (439).

**SPEC2 affordance-override seam** = `REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS` (al.ts:209) / `POST_TARGET_REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS` (213) — экспортированные `Map`, заполняемые модулями `.set()`; `AffordanceRequirement` имеет открытый `[key:string]:unknown` (27). И NPC-путь (`checkRequirements` 318/323) и player-путь (`validatePlayerAction` 532) гоняют ТОТ ЖЕ Map → bilateral parity (INV-16/17) сохраняется автоматически, ЕСЛИ override зарегистрирован как requirement-checker (а не как scoring-only эффект — иначе player его обойдёт, см. risks).

**Прецедент «strength scales from sentiment/trust»**: `il.ts:532` `effectiveConfidence = claim.confidence × playerTrust` и `checkPostTargetRequirements` gate `sentimentBelow` (al.ts:291) — обе SPEC-семьи масштабирования (sentiment-to-target, self-belief) имеют рабочий аналог в коде.

---

### Чистая форма seams (что есть; без реализации)

**SPEC1 — magnitude от self-belief:** читать `BeliefManager.getMaxConfidenceFor(selfId, matcher)` — но matcher/eventType ОБЯЗАН приходить от модуля (INV-14). «Self» сейчас = `subject===agent.profile.id` (module-конвенция: crime `index.ts:688`, `heat.ts:45 matchesSelf`); engine-примитива нет.
**SPEC1 — shift emits belief/memory:** идёт через ту же дорожку `registerBeliefCreator → addBelief`; memory — через `agent.memory.store` (agent.ts:160/247). Внимание на dedup-ключ `(eventType,object,source)` — новый source во избежание clobber крайм-beliefs.
**SPEC2 — strength от sentiment-to-target:** `getRelationship(targetId).sentiment` (raw, genre-neutral) — НЕ `sentimentCurve` (крайм-тюненые зоны). Для self/zone-источника sentiment отсутствует → fallback на self-belief.
**SPEC2 — strength от self-belief:** тот же `getMaxConfidenceFor(selfId, …)`.

**Не исследовано:** attributes.ts (B1 ScalarAttribute) / mood (deformation physics) — вне FOCUS; instinct-builder/personality-prose чтение bigFive; Enneagram stress/growth. Polit/economy module данные кроме как для подтверждения паттернов.

maps.reportMd:
## Map: Save/load + world-loader + world-editor — what a bigFive profile→state migration touches

**Допущения:** depth = deep (запрошена точная карта самого рискового churn). Memory `clwa/invariants` загружена; INV-21 в коде шире, чем в memory — см. ниже.

**TL;DR:** Сегодня `bigFive` живёт ТОЛЬКО на `AgentProfile` (статичный, immutable, пересобирается из world JSON при каждом boot) и НЕ попадает в `save.json` вообще. Персистятся только производные state-поля: `baseMood`, `attributes`, `factions`, `inventory`, `moodModifiers`. Миграция «personality → state-resident + persisted» затрагивает 4 слоя: (1) save-shape + toJSON/loadState в `world.ts`, (2) два boot-пути fresh-XOR-load в `index.ts`, (3) seeding из world JSON в `world-loader.ts` + `randomizeTraits`, (4) редактор JSON в `tools/world-editor`. Готовый паттерн для копирования — как уже персистятся `attributes`/`factions` (B1/B3).

---

### Где bigFive СЕЙЧАС: загрузка, персист, редактирование

**Загрузка (fresh):**
- `world-loader.ts:16-22` — `NpcJson.personality` = `{O,C,E,A,N,H}` (числа в JSON).
- `world-loader.ts:229-236` — маппинг `personality.O→bigFive.openness` … `personality.H→bigFive.honesty` при сборке `AgentProfile`. Это единственная точка чтения JSON-формы.
- `trait-randomizer.ts:66-91` (`randomizeTraits`) — МУТИРУЕТ `profile.bigFive[prop]` in-place после `loadWorld`, до `makeState`. Ключи через `TRAIT_KEY_MAP` (`trait-randomizer.ts:27-34`). Вызов: `index.ts:375-378`.
- `index.ts:300-308` (`makeState`) — `baseMood = 0.3 - N×0.4 + E×0.2` выводится из `profile.bigFive`. Это единственная state-производная от личности на сегодня.

**Персист:**
- `bigFive` НЕ сериализуется. `WorldSaveAgentData` (`world.ts:89-105`) содержит `baseMood/attributes/factions/inventory/...`, но НЕ personality.
- `World.toJSON()` (`world.ts:1882-1902`) пишет агента; personality отсутствует.
- При load профиль строится заново из world JSON (`createGameContext`→`loadWorld`, `index.ts:365/773`), затем поверх накладывается `loadState` (`index.ts:800`). То есть personality сегодня «восстанавливается» через пересборку профиля, НЕ через save.

**Редактирование:**
- `tools/world-editor/server.ts:143-156` — `GET/PUT /api/npcs/:id` читает/пишет сырой NPC JSON БЕЗ валидации (`writeJSON(body)`).
- `app.js:365-399` — слайдеры HEXACO биндят `data.personality[key]`, key ∈ {O,C,E,A,N,H}; рядом `randomRanges` (383-398).
- `app.js:446-464` — редакторы gold (`data.attributes.gold`) и factions (`data.factions`) — это и есть B1/B3-паттерн редактора.

---

### Что ИМЕННО трогает миграция profile.bigFive → state (точный список)

**A. Save-shape (`world.ts`):**
1. `world.ts:89-105` — добавить поле в `WorldSaveAgentData` (напр. `personality?` как открытый Record осей).
2. `world.ts:1892-1894` — добавить запись в `toJSON()` строго по паттерну `...(state.x ? { x: state.x } : {})` (иначе пустые агенты ломают тест «empty state round-trips cleanly», save-load.test.ts:327).
3. `world.ts:1992-2004` — добавить блок восстановления по образцу `saved.attributes`: re-clamp + `Number.isFinite` фильтр (SL-07).
4. **INV-21:** `world.ts:1988` — образец default-on-load (`saved.baseMood ?? derive`). Personality на старых сейвах будет ОТСУТСТВОВАТЬ → нужен `saved.personality ?? <из profile.bigFive>`.

**B. State-тип (`agent-types.ts`):**
5. `agent-types.ts:141-188` — добавить personality-блок в `AgentState` (рядом с `attributes?`/`factions?`).
6. `agent-types.ts:0-7` — `BigFive` сейчас ЗАКРЫТ (6 ключей). Открытый реестр осей ломает типизацию `Record<keyof BigFive>` в `al.ts:391`, `trait-randomizer.ts:27`, `instinct-builder.ts:199`.

**C. Boot-пути (`index.ts`) — INV-21 XOR:**
7. `index.ts:300-326` (`makeState`) — FRESH: засеять state-personality из profile (после randomizeTraits).
8. `index.ts:728-736` — паттерн засева attributes/factions (`world.setAttribute`/`joinFaction`); personality-seeder должен встроиться сюда тем же образом ЛИБО в makeState.
9. `index.ts:796-832` — LOAD: `loadState` (800) восстановит persisted personality; FRESH-путь (`createGameContext`) засевает. **Оба пути обязательны.**
10. `index.ts:519,544` — player строится вручную с литеральным bigFive; INV-16 bilateral → player тоже должен получить state-personality (у player нет NPC JSON).

**D. Загрузчик/рандомайзер:**
11. `world-loader.ts:229-236` — если JSON-форма personality меняется, маппинг меняется здесь.
12. `trait-randomizer.ts:66-91` — **критичный порядок:** рандомизация мутирует profile до makeState. Если personality персистится, рандомайзер должен писать в persisted-блок при fresh, но НЕ перезаписывать загруженный (иначе пластически сдвинутая личность затирается ре-рандомизацией каждый boot).

**E. Редактор:**
13. `world-editor/server.ts:150-155` — PUT пишет body как есть, без схемы. `app.js:365-399` слайдеры. При смене JSON-формы personality редактор и loader (`world-loader.ts:16-22,229-236`) меняются синхронно.
14. `world-editor/server.ts:98-121` — `/api/registry` собирает union открытых ключей (factions/capabilities) из данных NPC; если оси личности станут открытыми, аналогичный union-механизм уже есть как образец.

**F. Тесты:**
15. `save-load.test.ts:208-264` — round-trip + anti-vacuous setup (`createTestWorld` 120-137 явно засевает attributes/factions, чтобы тест не проходил вхолостую) + SL-07 NaN-defense. Нужен аналог для personality.
16. `save-load.test.ts:378-382` — тест присутствия `baseMood` в snapshot; образец для personality-присутствия.

---

### Паттерн attributes/factions (что копировать дословно)

`ScalarAttribute` (`attributes.ts:25-35`): `{base, min, max, modifiers[], drift?}` — base+clamp+modifiers, `drift?` опционален с INV-21-комментарием прямо в типе. Цикл персиста:
- toJSON: `world.ts:1892-1893` — omit-when-absent.
- loadState: `world.ts:1992-2006` — для каждого ключа `Number.isFinite(a.base)` проверка, `createAttribute` ре-клампит, modifiers финит-фильтруются, drift восстанавливается только если finite.
- seed: `index.ts:728-735` через `world.setAttribute`/`joinFaction` (движок владеет state, сервер только наполняет).
- editor: `app.js:446-464`.

Это и есть эталон для нового персистируемого personality-блока (если он идёт по модели base+modifiers как mood/B1).

---

### Что НЕ исследовано (вне scope)
- ~30 read-сайтов `agent.profile.bigFive` перечислены в integrationPoints/risks, но их редирект на effective-getter — это отдельная карта (al/cg/volition/instinct/il/topic/scheduler/crime-модули). Здесь только отмечено как риск blast-radius.
- Сама механика плотности/пластичности (SPEC 1) и affordance-space (SPEC 2) — не картировались, фокус был на save/load/editor.
- positions/journal/events персист (`index.ts:257-270`) — соседние слои save.json, не связаны с personality напрямую.

agent-types.ts:82 AgentProfile.bigFive (static, immutable) vs agent-types.ts:142 AgentState (mutable: baseMood, moodModifiers, attributes) — SPEC 1 must relocate trait reads from profile to a deformable state layer; 29 bigFive refs in engine across 11 files, plus 4 module files.
al.ts:391 TRAIT_MAP + al.ts:451 computeUtility trait read — closed OCEAN+H map; SPEC 1 'open axis registry' replaces this lookup.
risks: BILATERAL PARITY SPLIT (INV-16/17): validatePlayerAction (al.ts:510) re-implements requirement iteration separately from checkRequirements (al.ts:304). It iterates ONLY REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS (al.ts:532) — it does NOT call checkPostTargetRequirements, so POST_TARGET_REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS (maxWitnesses, sentimentBelow, noGuardNearby) are NEVER enforced for the player. Any SPEC 2 cross-agent/zone gate registered as a post-target checker would silently not apply to the player. A self/cross affordance override must be wired into BOTH paths or parity is asymmetric.

validatePlayerAction passes NO event and never resolves a finder-based target — it only validates an explicitly supplied targetId (al.ts:539). A cross-agent affordance modifier that depends on finder-discovered targets has no player-side equivalent.

NO ZONE PRIMITIVE EXISTS: LocationDef (world-types.ts:24) has only id/name/connections/isPublic — no mutable state, no attributes, no modifier list. 'Zone Z as active object of reality' (SPEC 2 zone-source) has nowhere to store its affordance-modifier state today; locations are not agents and are not iterated by the tick/decay loop (world.ts:561 iterates ctx.agents only).

computeUtility (al.ts:447) is GATE-INDEPENDENT: a modifier that should make an action POSSIBLE/IMPOSSIBLE belongs in checkRequirements (binary), not computeUtility (continuous score). Strength-scaling (belief/sentiment) belongs in scoring; possibility-toggling belongs in the checkers. Conflating them risks 'scored but impossible' or 'possible but never chosen' affordances.

REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS/SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS are PROCESS-GLOBAL mutable registries (al.ts:209/438); tests must clear them (clearScoringContributors:445 exists; no clear for REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS). New SPEC 2 registries inherit this cross-test pollution hazard (already flagged in m5-review workflow).

reactive path (checkRequirementsReactive al.ts:333) deliberately SKIPS the mood gate but still runs all registry checkers — a self-affordance-override that should block under all conditions must not assume the proactive-only gates run.

bigFive lives on the IMMUTABLE AgentProfile (agent-types.ts:92), read in 29 engine sites; SPEC 1 making personality deformable means every read site (al.ts:451 computeUtility, instinct-builder, volition:385, personality-prose, scheduler, topic-engine, il, cg-engine + 4 module files) must move to an effective() accessor. High blast radius; missing one site = stale static trait silently used.
TRAIT_MAP (al.ts:391) is a CLOSED 6-entry record typed against profile.bigFive keys; SPEC 1's open-axis registry cannot be a typed keyof lookup — type-level change, not just data.

## Map: AL pipeline + perception + zones (SPEC 2 hooks) + tick lifecycle (SPEC 1)

**TL;DR:** Допущение по глубине: medium+ (трассированы ключевые функции + точки врезки, без построчного чтения всех файлов). Возможное множество действий считается в `al.ts` через две зеркальные функции-гейта (`checkRequirements` проактивно, `checkRequirementsReactive` реактивно), которые итерируют по двум module-наполняемым реестрам чекеров (pre-target + post-target) — это и есть готовая, genre-neutral точка для SPEC 2 «состояние меняет множество возможных действий». Сила/score модификатора отдельно живёт в `computeUtility` через `SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS`. Player идёт через `validatePlayerAction` (билатеральный паритет), но эта функция дублирует логику гейта и НЕ вызывает post-target чекеры — главный риск асимметрии. Тик-жизненный цикл (decay/anneal плюс жизнь модификаторов) врезается через `registerTickPhaseHandler`, который в `world.ts:1382` исполняется над всеми агентами (включая игрока). SPEC 1 переиспользует ровно ту же деформационную машинерию mood (`baseMood + Σ modifierEffective`, INV-06) и B1 `ScalarAttribute` (`base + clamp + modifiers + drift`).

**Architecture (что есть и как связано):**
- `al.ts` — модель аффорданса + 4 реестра (`REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS`:209, `POST_TARGET_REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS`:213, `TARGET_FINDERS`/`REACTIVE_TARGET_FINDERS`:200/203, `SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS`:438). Чистый движок: `AffordanceRequirement` имеет открытый индекс `[key]: unknown` (al.ts:27) — модуль кладёт ЛЮБОЙ ключ требования, движок его не перечисляет (INV-14).
- `volition.ts` — драйвер AL. `evaluateAllVolition`:127 (проактивный per-tick цикл) и `evaluateReactiveVolition`:207 (на CE-событие). Оба пропускают игрока (`isPlayer` :139, :230).
- `perception.ts` — co-presence: `getCoPresent`:55, `getWitnesses`:69 (билатеральны, считают игрока). Это естественное место, чтобы перечислить «кто присутствует, чтобы спроецировать модификатор на T».
- `world-types.ts` — `LocationDef`:24 / `LocationGraph`:34. Единственный пространственный примитив, БЕЗ изменяемого состояния. Для «zone Z как активный объект» (SPEC 2 zone-source) дома сейчас НЕТ.
- `event-registry.ts` — `registerTickPhaseHandler`:696, `TickPhaseContext`:670; `world.ts:1382` крутит все хендлеры за тик.
- `attributes.ts` / `world.ts` — деформационная машинерия (см. ниже).

**Data flow — как считается ВОЗМОЖНОЕ множество (проактивно):**
`evaluateAllVolition` (volition.ts:154) → `for aff of AFFORDANCE_REGISTRY` → `checkRequirements(aff, npcId, agent, ctx)` (al.ts:160→304):
1. Универсальные pre-target гейты: period (al.ts:313), moodBelow (314), suppressNearPlayer (315).
2. `checkRegistryRequirements` (al.ts:318→269): итерация по `REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS`, передаётся ВЕСЬ объект `requires` как `params`. ← **SPEC 2 self-override (per-agent) врезается здесь как module-registered checker.**
3. `findTarget` (al.ts:320→359): `targetRole`→`findByRole`, иначе `TARGET_FINDERS.get(key)`. ← **cross-agent reach (A→T): T-сторонняя осведомлённость о наложенном модификаторе резолвится тут.**
4. `checkPostTargetRequirements` (al.ts:323→280): universal maxWitnesses/sentimentBelow + `POST_TARGET_REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS`. ← **гейты, которым нужен резолвленный target (cross-agent/zone) живут здесь.**
→ если target != null → `computeUtility` (al.ts:162→447) → score → если ≥ MIN_SCORE кладётся в `scored[]` → LLM решает (`llmDecideAndBuild`).

Реактивный путь идентичен, но через `checkRequirementsReactive` (al.ts:333) — mood-гейт намеренно пропущен (события важнее настроения), остальные гейты те же.

`computeUtility` (al.ts:447) — 6 каналов: personality (OCEAN+H через `TRAIT_MAP`:391), mood (`moodCurve`), relationship (`sentimentCurve`), belief modifiers, trust, и `SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS` (al.ts:486). ← **сила модификатора, масштабируемая от belief(self)/sentiment(target), идёт сюда как scoring contributor — НЕ в гейт.** Возможность (бинарно) и сила (непрерывно) — два разных слоя; смешивать опасно (см. risks).

**Bilateral path (игрок):**
`validatePlayerAction` (al.ts:510) — отдельная функция «можно ли». Находит аффорданс (517), проверяет period (524), затем итерирует ТОЛЬКО `REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS` (al.ts:532, тот же реестр что у NPC — паритет INV-17), затем co-location явно переданного targetId (539). **НЕ вызывает `checkPostTargetRequirements`** → post-target чекеры для игрока не применяются. Сейчас функция экспортируется (`index.ts:57`) но к серверному player-action эндпоинту НЕ подключена (в `routes.ts` только debug `force-affordance`:1055 для NPC).

**Tick lifecycle (SPEC 1 decay/anneal):**
`world.ts:561` — главный per-tick цикл над `ctx.agents` (включая игрока — билатерально): `_computeMoodTick` пересчитывает `mood = clamp(baseMood + Σ modifierEffective(m))` (world.ts:549-550, INV-06); сразу после — `decayAttribute` + `driftAttribute` по всем B1-атрибутам (world.ts:592). Затем `_handlePhaseHandlers` (world.ts:1367) крутит `getTickPhaseHandlers()` (1382). ← **plastic decay/anneal + жизнь affordance-модификаторов врезается через `registerTickPhaseHandler` (бесплатно билатерально, т.к. цикл над всеми агентами).**

**Deformation machinery, которую переиспользует SPEC 1:**
- Эластичная (mood): `addModifier`:611 (единственная точка мутации, INV-06), `MoodModifier` decay-модель `exponential|linear|none` (world-types.ts:5), `modifierEffective` пружинит к baseMood.
- Пластичная (B1): `ScalarAttribute` = `base + min/max + modifiers[] + drift?` (attributes.ts:26). `adjustAttributeBase`:674 в world.ts УЖЕ делает перманентный сдвиг базы (= «plastic set»). `driftAttribute`:76 — экспоненциальный/линейный дрейф базы (= «annealing» knob, опциональный).
- `bigFive` живёт на ИММУТАБЕЛЬНОМ `AgentProfile`:92 (29 чтений в движке по 11 файлам + 4 модульных). `TRAIT_MAP`:391 — ЗАКРЫТАЯ типизированная 6-ключевая запись. SPEC 1 «open axes» + «деформируемая personality» требует переноса чтений на effective()-аксессор и снятия типовой замкнутости TRAIT_MAP.

**Key decisions / patterns:**
1. Возможность vs сила разделены: гейты (`checkRequirements`) бинарны, `computeUtility` непрерывен (al.ts:304 vs 447). SPEC 2 self/cross override как module-data: «можно/нельзя» → checker-реестр; «насколько хочется» → scoring contributor.
2. Открытый словарь требований: `AffordanceRequirement[key]:unknown` + generic-итерация (al.ts:27, 269) — ноль движковой лексики (INV-14). Существующие модули (crime/economy) уже регистрируют ~15 чекеров так (crime-justice/index.ts:74-109, economy/index.ts:63-70).
3. Зеркало проактив/реактив через общий `checkRegistryRequirements`/`checkPostTargetRequirements` — одна врезка покрывает оба, КРОМЕ player-пути (отдельный).
4. Существующий transient personality-shift — `getStressGrowthDirective` (personality-prose.ts:46): чисто prompt-текст по live mood, без состояния. Это НЕ деформация — плойность нужно делать state-backed, а не навешивать на неё.

**Gotchas:**
- `validatePlayerAction` не зовёт post-target чекеры (al.ts:510 vs 280) — потенциальная дыра паритета для SPEC 2.
- Зоны (`LocationDef`) не имеют состояния и не итерируются tick-циклом (world.ts:561 = только agents) — «zone Z» как источник модификатора негде хранить и нечем тикать сегодня.
- Реестры process-global mutable; тесты должны их чистить (`clearScoringContributors`:445 есть, для `REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS` — нет).
- `isPlayer`-гайды разнятся по путям: volition исключает игрока, tick/perception — включают. Tick-хендлер плойности билатерален «бесплатно».

**Referenced answers:**
- Q: Где врезается «A/zone Z меняет множество возможных действий T»? / A: возможность — в `REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS` (self, al.ts:269/318) и `POST_TARGET_REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS` (нужен target T, al.ts:280/297); reach к T — в `TARGET_FINDERS`/`findTarget` (al.ts:359) + `getCoPresent` (perception.ts:55); сила (belief/sentiment-scaled) — в `SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS`/`computeUtility` (al.ts:438/447).
- Q: Билатеральный путь? / A: `validatePlayerAction` (al.ts:510), тот же `REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS` (532), НО без post-target — врезку SPEC 2 надо завести в ОБА (или достроить post-target в player-путь).
- Q: Где тикает plastic decay/anneal? / A: `registerTickPhaseHandler` (event-registry.ts:696) → `world.ts:1382`; рядом — деформ-машинерия mood (world.ts:549) и B1 drift (world.ts:592, attributes.ts:76).

**Not explored (вне фокуса):**
- Внутренности `il.ts` (IL claim→addBelief паритет) — упомянут как seam, не трассирован.
- `instinct-builder.ts` / `buildDecisionPrompt` prose-генерация (читает bigFive, но это рендер, не гейт).
- CG-движок (`cg-engine.ts`) и belief/relationship внутренности (seam'ы SPEC 1 magnitude-scaling) — не входили в фокус AL/perception/zones.
- Сохранение/загрузка (INV-21 defaults) новых плойность/модификатор-полей — не проверял.

synthesis.engineLaw:
# Engine Law — Personality Plasticity (the deformation physics)

ONE LAW, restated genre-neutrally: an agent's quantified state is a `base` value plus a sum of decaying `modifiers`, clamped to a range. ELASTIC change = a modifier (springs back as it decays). PLASTIC change = a permanent shift of `base`. This law already exists twice (mood: `_computeMoodTick` world.ts:547-550; ScalarAttribute: `attributeEffective` attributes.ts:54). Personality Plasticity does NOT invent a third — it routes personality through the EXISTING ScalarAttribute primitive. No new deformation math is written. The "unify physics" locked decision is satisfied by REUSE, not by migrating mood onto ScalarAttribute (rejected — see DD-04).

## The four engine knobs (the law; values are module data)

A `PlasticityRule` is module-registered data evaluated by ONE engine evaluator each tick / on each event. The engine owns the LAW; modules own trigger/mode/magnitude/reversibility values.

1. TRIGGER — `when: { eventType?: string; abilityUse?: string; predicate?(ctx): boolean }`. Any event, INCLUDING an agent's own action/ability-use (the SPEC-2 seam supplies `abilityUse`). Engine matches; it never enumerates module event vocabulary (INV-14).

2. MODE — `mode: 'threshold' | 'accumulation'`.
   - threshold: when the per-rule accumulator crosses `threshold`, apply `step` to the axis base ONCE and reset accumulator (a single decisive event sets you).
   - accumulation: each trigger adds `step × magnitudeScale` to the axis base directly (slow erosion). No accumulator.
   The accumulator is per-(agentId, ruleId) state, stored as a ScalarAttribute under a reserved key prefix so it persists for free (see dataModel).

3. MAGNITUDE — `step: number` (signed, axis units) optionally multiplied by `magnitudeScale`, a module-supplied function reading the bearer's self-belief confidence (beliefs seam) and/or sentiment-to-target (relationships seam). Engine clamps the result finite; the axis clamp [min,max] bounds the cumulative set.

4. REVERSIBILITY / ANNEALING — maps cleanly onto the EXISTING optional `drift` field of ScalarAttribute (attributes.ts:35). `anneal?: { ratePerMinute; toward }` on the rule writes `drift` onto the axis attribute the first time it shifts. Absent = no drift = IRREVERSIBLE (the default). driftAttribute (attributes.ts:76) already runs in the real-tick loop (world.ts:592) for every attribute — annealing needs ZERO new tick code.

## Tick / event integration (no new loops)
- Event-driven rules fire from a single `registerTickPhaseHandler` evaluator the engine installs once (PP module-agnostic core). It iterates `ctx.agents` (bilateral — includes player, INV-16) and matches each agent's recent events / accumulators against registered rules. Decisive 'threshold' shifts that should react to a specific event are evaluated when that event is processed (the same handler reads the per-tick event/approach context).
- Decay of accumulator and annealing of axis base ride the EXISTING `decayAttribute`/`driftAttribute` calls at world.ts:592 — because both accumulator and trait axis ARE ScalarAttributes. dt=5 is inherited, so no mis-scaling (risk addressed).
- A plastic base shift calls `adjustAttributeBase` (world.ts:674) — the ALREADY-EXISTING permanent-base op. This is the legal PLASTIC write, the exact analogue the code maps identified.
synthesis.dataModel:
# Data Model — traits become state-backed ScalarAttributes (the SAFE migration)

## Decision: traits live in AgentState as ScalarAttributes, with profile.bigFive kept as the IMMUTABLE SEED.

Carrier: extend `AgentState` (agent-types.ts:142) with NO new bespoke struct. Reuse `attributes` (agent-types.ts:154) under a reserved, engine-owned key namespace:

- Trait axes stored as `attributes['trait:O']`, `attributes['trait:C']`, ... `attributes['trait:H']`, and module axes as `attributes['trait:<axisKey>']`. min=0, max=1, base=seed.
- Plasticity accumulators stored as `attributes['pp:<ruleId>']` (min=0, max=Infinity, base=accumulated).

Why reuse `attributes` rather than a new `personality` block:
- It is ALREADY persisted (toJSON world.ts:1892, load world.ts:1992-2004 with SL-07 NaN defense + drift preservation). ZERO new save/load code, ZERO new WorldSaveAgentData field, ZERO new INV-21 default branch — the existing `saved.attributes ?? absent` path covers old saves. This directly defuses the "PERSISTENCE GAP (highest)" risk: deformed state moves into AgentState exactly as the code maps demanded, but via the field that ALREADY round-trips.
- It is ALREADY decayed+drifted in the real tick (world.ts:592) → annealing free.
- It is ALREADY CG-gateable (`attr` op cg-engine.ts:292) and scoreable (SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS) — a feature, but the genre-neutrality test must tolerate the `trait:`/`pp:` prefixes (no domain words; INV-14 holds — "trait" is a universal psychometric term, not "wound"/"Negation").

The reserved `trait:` / `pp:` prefix is the engine's ONE convention. It is namespaced so module attributes (gold, hp) never collide, and so a future "list trait axes" query is a cheap prefix scan.

## The effective() accessor — the single read seam
Add `agent.trait(axisKey: string): number` on the Agent class (agent.ts), defined as:
`attributeEffective(state.attributes?['trait:'+axisKey]) ?? profile.bigFive[<mapped OCEAN+H key>] ?? 0.5`.
Fallback chain: state axis (deformed) → profile seed (un-migrated/old) → neutral 0.5. This guarantees a site reads the deformed value if it exists and the static seed otherwise — NO split-brain (the central INV-06-parity risk), and INV-21 safe for axes never seeded into state.

## Open-axis registry
`registerTraitAxis(key: string, opts: { seed?: number; min?: number; max?: number })`. Engine seeds the six OCEAN+H axes itself at boot (so the engine still "knows" OCEAN+H as its built-in seed set — that is allowed; they are universal psychometrics, not module content). Modules call `registerTraitAxis('stability', {...})` etc. The registry is the open replacement for the closed `BigFive` interface — but `BigFive` STAYS as the typed seed shape on AgentProfile (immutable), so the closed `keyof BigFive` typings (TRAIT_KEY_MAP, instinct-builder inline type) still compile (tsc-0). New axes are reached via the string-keyed `agent.trait(key)` path, never the typed one.
synthesis.seams:
# The three seams (all genre-neutral, all null-safe)

## Seam A — SPEC 2 ability-use is a plasticity trigger ("a piece of yourself")
`PlasticityRule.when.abilityUse` matches the id of an affordance-space modifier that SPEC 2 registers. When SPEC 2's modifier is USED (the engine emits a use-event into the tick context), the PP evaluator matches `abilityUse` and applies the shift. Crucially: the engine ships NO coupling code — SPEC 2 emits a normal event; PP matches it by string. This keeps the two specs independently testable and lets the "Negation" world wire "using a power costs who-you-are" as pure rule data. Verified seam point: the per-tick PP evaluator runs in the SAME tick-phase loop that already carries `approaches`/event context (event-registry.ts:670-690), so ability-use events are visible without new plumbing.

## Seam B — magnitude scaled from self-belief (beliefs)
`magnitudeScale(ctx)` calls `ctx.selfBeliefConfidence(matcher)`, a thin wrapper over the EXISTING `BeliefManager.getMaxConfidenceFor(selfId, matcher)` (beliefs.ts:82). The engine exposes NO "self-belief" concept — `selfId = agent.profile.id` is passed by the wrapper; the matcher (which eventTypes count as self-relevant) is MODULE-supplied (INV-14 preserved; addresses the "no engine self-belief primitive" risk). Confidence is bounded [0.1,1] (floored by decay), so module authors must NOT assume a 0 floor (risk noted). A shift may also EMIT a belief via `rule.emitBelief` → `BeliefManager.addBelief`; the emitted (eventType,object,source) triple MUST be module-distinct or it silently reinforces a crime belief (addBelief dedups by that triple, beliefs.ts:55 — risk surfaced to module authors, engine stays neutral).

## Seam C — magnitude scaled from sentiment-to-target (relationships)
`ctx.sentimentTo(targetId)` wraps `RelationshipGraph.getRelationship(targetId)?.sentiment ?? 0` (relationships.ts:64). RAW sentiment, NOT `sentimentCurve` (which carries crime-tuned thresholds — genre-neutral choice, resolves that risk). Self-directed triggers have no relationship row (`getRelationship(self)` → null) → fall back to self-belief (Seam B). Strangers (no row) → 0, so a module wanting a stranger floor supplies it in `magnitudeScale` (mirrors getTestimonyWeight's 0.3 fallback pattern). adjustStanding is irrelevant here (it doesn't fire onChange — noted, not used).

## Relation to Enneagram stress/growth (NOT a seam — a disambiguation)
getStressGrowthDirective (personality-prose.ts:46) is ELASTIC and PROSE-ONLY: it reads live `mood` thresholds and emits a system-prompt string, mutating no state. Plasticity is the orthogonal PLASTIC axis. They COMPOSE without double-counting: a plastic shift can move `baseMood` or a `stability` axis, which then changes which Enneagram band `mood` falls into — the connection is INDIRECT (via mood), never a direct write to the Enneagram directive. No code change to personality-prose.ts.
synthesis.migration:
# bigFive profile→state migration (additive, INV-21-clean, no data loss)

## The subtle ordering trap (resolved)
trait-randomizer.ts:67-92 mutates `profile.bigFive` in-place at boot, AFTER loadWorld, BEFORE makeState — and runs EVERY boot. If trait baselines become persisted state, re-randomization on a LOADED save would clobber a plastic shift. Resolution:
- profile.bigFive REMAINS the immutable seed and randomizer keeps writing it (no change to trait-randomizer) — it is the world-JSON-equivalent baseline.
- The state axes (`attributes['trait:X']`) are seeded FROM the (already-randomized) profile.bigFive ONLY on FRESH boot, in the same place attributes/factions are seeded (server index.ts:728-736 pattern). On LOADED boot, `loadState` restores `attributes` (incl. `trait:`/`pp:` keys) and the fresh seeder is SKIPPED — so a saved plastic shift survives. This is exactly the attributes/factions XOR-boot discipline that already exists; we copy it.

## Read-site migration (the blast radius — ~17 engine + 4 module sites)
Every `agent.profile.bigFive[X]` read switches to `agent.trait('X')` (or `world.getTrait`). Because `trait()` falls back to profile.bigFive when no state axis exists, the switch is SAFE even before seeding (un-migrated agents read the seed). Sites:
- al.ts:451 computeUtility personality channel; al.ts:457 moodCurve honesty arg.
- instinct-builder.ts:205 (getResistanceVoice) — pass an axis-reader instead of the bigFive struct.
- volition.ts:385 / agent.ts:267,408,524 (bigFiveToDescription) — build a synthetic BigFive view from `trait()` for the six OCEAN+H keys so the prose fn is unchanged.
- cg-engine.ts:344 checkTrait — ALREADY string-keyed (casts to Record<string,number>); redirect it to read state axis first, falling back to profile — keeps its open contract, and it becomes the natural reader of module axes.
- world.ts:536 (social-stress N/A/H), :578 (loneliness E), :1988 (baseMood seed from N/E) — these DERIVE from traits. Switch to `trait()` so a plastic N shift propagates. baseMood seed at :1988 keeps reading profile.bigFive (it's the FRESH/old-save default; a plastic N shift updates baseMood through an explicit recompute path in applyPlasticShift if a module wires N→baseMood, NOT passively — resolves the "derived-from-trait double-count" risk).
- il.ts:626-627, topic-engine.ts:238-239, scheduler.ts:133-134, social/topic-sources.ts:664, crime-justice index/step-handlers/investigation — same mechanical switch to `trait()`.
- routes.ts:118/801/819 + game.js:1919 — serialize EFFECTIVE traits via `trait()` so the UI shows deformed values; shape stays `{O..H}` numbers (frontend unaffected).

## Player (INV-16 bilateral)
Player is hand-built (index.ts:519) with a literal bigFive and no attributes until seeded. The fresh-seed step explicitly covers 'player' so the player gets `trait:` axes too — player HAS plasticity and IS a valid plasticity source/target. The PP tick evaluator iterates ctx.agents (incl. player), so no NPC-only filter is added (risk noted).

## World-editor lockstep
Editor (tools/world-editor) edits `data.personality{O..H}` → that maps to the profile SEED only. No editor change needed for v1 (axes are derived from the seed at boot). Documented as the contract so a future "edit live plastic state" feature knows the seed≠state distinction.

# Phasing — additive before destructive (each phase: tsc 0, bun test green, oracle behavior unchanged)

PHASE 0 (read-seam, PURE additive, behavior-identical):
- Add `Agent.trait(axis)` accessor + `registerTraitAxis`/`getTraitAxes` with OCEAN+H engine-seeded.
- Switch ALL ~17 engine + 4 module read sites from `profile.bigFive[X]` to `agent.trait('X')`. With no state axes seeded yet, `trait()` returns the profile seed → byte-identical behavior. tsc 0; full suite green; crime+economy oracle UNCHANGED (no axes exist yet). This is the safety-establishing phase — it proves the seam before any state exists.

PHASE 1 (state-back the axes, still no rules):
- Seed `attributes['trait:O'..'H']` from profile.bigFive on FRESH boot (server seeder) for NPCs AND player. loadState already round-trips them (no save/load code). Now `trait()` reads state. Behavior still identical (base = seed). Save-load round-trip test extended to assert trait axes persist. INV-21: old saves lack `trait:` keys → `trait()` falls back to profile seed → no zeroing.

PHASE 2 (the LAW — PlasticityRule + evaluator):
- Add PlasticityRule schema, registry, the single tick-phase evaluator, accumulators (`pp:<id>` attributes), `World.applyPlasticShift`/`addTraitModifier`/`getTrait`, `onTraitChange` callback. No rules registered → no shifts → behavior unchanged. Engine-level tests register a synthetic neutral-domain rule (e.g. axis 'curiosity', eventType 'test_event') to prove threshold + accumulation + anneal + magnitudeScale, with clearPlasticityRules in afterAll.

PHASE 3 (seams):
- Wire selfBeliefConfidence/sentimentTo wrappers + emitBelief path. Tests prove magnitude scales from belief confidence and sentiment, and that an emitted belief uses a distinct source.

PHASE 4 (SPEC-2 trigger seam):
- Once SPEC 2 ships its affordance-modifier use-event, `when.abilityUse` matching is validated end-to-end. (Decoupled — PP doesn't block on SPEC 2.)

NO DESTRUCTIVE STEP: `profile.bigFive` is NEVER removed — it stays as the immutable seed forever. trait-randomizer keeps writing it. `BigFive` interface stays (closed typings keep compiling). The "destructive" deletion the naive design implied (remove bigFive from profile) is consciously rejected — keeping the seed is what makes the migration reversible and INV-21-trivial.
synthesis.testPlan:
# Test Plan

## New engine tests (tests/plasticity.test.ts — neutral domain only, INV-14)
1. registerTraitAxis adds an open axis; getTraitAxes includes OCEAN+H + the new one.
2. Agent.trait fallback chain: no state axis → profile seed; seeded axis → effective(base+mods); neither → 0.5.
3. applyPlasticShift moves base permanently; clamps to [0,1]; rejects NaN; fires onTraitChange only when |Δ|>0.0005.
4. mode='threshold': accumulator (`pp:<id>`) crosses threshold → ONE step applied → accumulator resets. Sub-threshold → no shift.
5. mode='accumulation': each trigger adds step×magnitudeScale directly; many triggers erode base monotonically until axis clamp.
6. anneal: a shifted axis with `anneal` set drifts base toward `toward` over ticks (driftAttribute path); without anneal, base is frozen (irreversible default).
7. magnitudeScale reads selfBeliefConfidence (seed a self-belief, assert larger shift) and sentimentTo (seed sentiment, assert scaling); strangers → scale uses module fallback.
8. emitBelief writes a belief with a distinct source; re-trigger does NOT clobber a crime belief (distinct triple).
9. clearPlasticityRules isolates tests (process-global registry hygiene, mirrors clearScoringContributors).

## Save/load (extend tests/save-load.test.ts)
10. Round-trip: an agent with shifted `trait:` axes + a `pp:` accumulator → identical JSON after save/load; SL-07 NaN in a trait axis is sanitized.
11. INV-21: an OLD save lacking `trait:` keys loads → trait() returns profile seed, no zeroing; empty agent (bob) still round-trips cleanly (`...(x?{x}:{})` omit-when-empty already covers it via the attributes field).
12. Loaded plastic shift is NOT re-randomized: load a save with shifted trait:N, assert trait('N') ≠ profile.bigFive.neuroticism after boot (fresh-seeder skipped on load).

## Regression / parity (extend existing suites)
13. PHASE 0/1 oracle: crime + economy behavior tests UNCHANGED with zero rules registered (proves additive).
14. Bilateral (INV-16): player agent gets trait: axes; applyPlasticShift on player works; validatePlayerAction still passes (PP is not a requirement-checker, so no player gating asymmetry introduced).
15. computeUtility reads deformed trait: shift trait:H, assert moodCurve honesty arg and personality channel both use the new value (no split-brain — single accessor).

## Architecture / INV-14
16. Architecture test: engine source contains NO module strings (Negation/trauma/wound/debt) — the `trait:`/`pp:` prefixes and 'threshold'/'accumulation' are universal, allowed.
17. tsc --noEmit = 0 after every phase (closed BigFive typings still compile; open axes reached only via string `trait()`).
synthesis.api: No external API/library involved — this is an internal engine-layer design (Bun + TypeScript ESM). The "API" surface is the engine's own public functions documented in ruleOrApiSchema: registerTraitAxis/getTraitAxes, registerPlasticityRule/getPlasticityRules/clearPlasticityRules, World.getTrait/applyPlasticShift/addTraitModifier/onTraitChange, and Agent.trait(axis). All reuse existing primitives (ScalarAttribute, registerTickPhaseHandler, the attributes save/load path) — no new third-party dependency.

decisions.decision: Personality traits become state-backed ScalarAttributes stored in the EXISTING AgentState.attributes map under a reserved 'trait:<axis>' key namespace; profile.bigFive is kept as an immutable SEED.
decisions.rationale: Defuses the highest risk (persistence gap) with ZERO new save/load code: attributes already round-trip with SL-07 NaN defense (world.ts:1892,1992-2004) and already decay+drift in the real tick (world.ts:592). Annealing and persistence come for free. INV-21 is trivial — old saves lack trait: keys and the accessor falls back to the seed.
decisions.rejected: A new bespoke AgentState.personality block (requires new WorldSaveAgentData field + new toJSON/load branches + new INV-21 default + new tick decay loop — four new failure surfaces for no gain). Mutating profile.bigFive at runtime (rejected outright: profile is not serialized — silent data loss on reload).

decisions.decision: REUSE ScalarAttribute as-is for the deformation physics. Do NOT migrate mood onto ScalarAttribute to literally unify the code paths.
decisions.rationale: The locked 'unify physics' decision is honored by reusing the SAME base+Σdecaying-modifiers+clamp+drift law that ScalarAttribute embodies — personality joins that machinery. Migrating mood (its own MoodModifier type, _computeMoodTick shared with the side-effect-free calibration helper advanceMoodMath, calibrated durations) would be a large destructive refactor with oracle-behavior risk and the two modifierEffective copies are identical anyway.
decisions.rejected: Collapsing MoodModifier and AttributeModifier into one type and moving baseMood into attributes — high blast radius, touches calibration math, violates additive-before-destructive for no behavioral benefit.

decisions.decision: Single read accessor Agent.trait(axis) with fallback chain state-axis → profile-seed → 0.5; ALL ~17 engine + 4 module bigFive read sites route through it.
decisions.rationale: Eliminates the split-brain risk (some sites read frozen base, others read deformed). The fallback makes Phase 0 byte-identical (no state seeded yet) so the seam can land and be proven BEFORE any plastic state exists.
decisions.rejected: Per-site ad-hoc reads of state.attributes['trait:X'] (guarantees a missed site → silent stale-trait bug). A getter on AgentProfile (profile is immutable and unserialized — wrong layer).

decisions.decision: Open-axis registry (registerTraitAxis) for module axes, but KEEP the closed BigFive interface as the typed seed shape; module axes are reachable only via the string-keyed trait()/CG attr path.
decisions.rationale: Satisfies the locked OPEN-axes decision without breaking tsc-0: the closed keyof BigFive typings (TRAIT_KEY_MAP, instinct-builder inline type, TRAIT_MAP) keep compiling for the six engine-seeded axes; cg-engine.checkTrait is ALREADY string-keyed so it reads module axes natively.
decisions.rejected: Replacing BigFive with a fully open Record<string,number> on the profile — breaks every typed accessor, forces unsafe casts everywhere, loses compile-time safety on the OCEAN+H core for no functional gain.

decisions.decision: Reversibility/annealing is implemented by writing the EXISTING ScalarAttribute.drift field; absent drift = irreversible (default).
decisions.rationale: driftAttribute already runs every real tick for every attribute (world.ts:592). The optional drift field maps 1:1 onto the optional anneal knob — no new tick machinery, default-absent is exactly 'irreversible default'.
decisions.rejected: A separate anneal scheduler/loop (duplicates driftAttribute, risks double-decay or wrong dt scaling).

decisions.decision: PlasticityRule is module data; the engine ships ONE tick-phase evaluator registered via registerTickPhaseHandler; all three seams (ability-use, beliefs, relationships) are thin wrappers over existing primitives passed in PlasticityTriggerCtx.
decisions.rationale: registerTickPhaseHandler already iterates all agents bilaterally with event/approach context (event-registry.ts:670-700). selfBeliefConfidence wraps getMaxConfidenceFor(self,...) and sentimentTo wraps getRelationship — no new engine concepts, INV-14 preserved (self-id and matchers are supplied by the module, not enumerated by the engine).
decisions.rejected: Hardcoding belief/sentiment scaling inside the evaluator (would bake module vocabulary into the engine). A new dedicated plasticity tick loop (the existing tick-phase loop already provides the bilateral, event-aware pass).

decisions.decision: Plastic shifts use raw sentiment (not sentimentCurve) and self-belief subject = agent.profile.id supplied by the wrapper, never a hardcoded eventType set.
decisions.rationale: sentimentCurve carries crime-tuned non-linear thresholds; the genre-neutral engine must expose raw [-1,1]. Self vs other is a module convention (subject===self) — the engine exposes the query but the matcher stays module-supplied (INV-14).
decisions.rejected: Reusing sentimentCurve (imports crime tuning into a universal seam). Hardcoding which eventTypes are self-relevant (module knowledge in engine).

decisions.decision: profile.bigFive seeding of state axes happens ONLY on FRESH boot (mirroring attributes/factions XOR-boot); trait-randomizer keeps writing profile.bigFive unchanged.
decisions.rationale: Resolves the subtlest failure mode: re-randomization on a LOADED save would clobber plastic shifts. loadState restores trait: axes and the fresh-seeder is skipped, so saved shifts survive; randomizer output is the canonical seed used only for new games.
decisions.rejected: Seeding axes on every boot (clobbers loaded plastic state). Moving randomization output into the persisted block (couples a boot-time helper to save semantics, ordering-fragile).

decisions.decision: baseMood and other trait-derived values are recomputed only via an explicit module-wired path on applyPlasticShift, not passively re-derived each read.
decisions.rationale: baseMood is itself a deformable scalar; a plastic neuroticism shift must not be double-counted by both the stored baseMood and a passive re-read. The load-time baseMood default (world.ts:1988) keeps reading the profile SEED so a prior plastic shift is not re-applied; if a module wants N→baseMood coupling it wires it explicitly in a rule.
decisions.rejected: Passively recomputing baseMood from effective traits on every read (double-counts the plastic shift already folded into baseMood; couples mood to traits implicitly).

synthesis.reportMd:
# SPEC 1 — Personality Plasticity: Canonical Diamond Design

## The one-line law
Personality joins the SAME deformation physics that already backs mood and ScalarAttributes: `effective = clamp(base + Σ decaying modifiers, min, max)`. ELASTIC = a decaying modifier; PLASTIC = a permanent shift of `base`. The engine does NOT invent a third physics — it routes personality through the EXISTING `ScalarAttribute` primitive (`packages/engine/src/attributes.ts`).

## The single safest decision that unlocks everything
Store trait axes in the **existing** `AgentState.attributes` map under a reserved `trait:<axis>` key namespace (and plasticity accumulators under `pp:<ruleId>`), keeping `profile.bigFive` as the **immutable seed**.

This one choice collapses the entire risk surface the code maps flagged:
- PERSISTENCE GAP (the highest risk): SOLVED with zero new code — `attributes` already round-trips through `toJSON` (`world.ts:1892`) and `loadState` with SL-07 NaN defense (`world.ts:1992-2004`). No new `WorldSaveAgentData` field, no new INV-21 branch.
- ANNEALING: free — `driftAttribute` already runs every real tick at `world.ts:592` for every attribute. The optional `anneal` knob writes the existing `ScalarAttribute.drift` field; absent = irreversible (the locked default).
- CG-gateable + scoreable: the existing `attr` CG op (`cg-engine.ts:292`) and SCORING_CONTRIBUTORS channel read these axes for free.

## No split-brain: one accessor
Add `Agent.trait(axis)` = `attributeEffective(state.attributes['trait:'+axis]) ?? profile.bigFive[map] ?? 0.5`. ALL ~17 engine + 4 module `profile.bigFive` read sites switch to it (verified list: `al.ts:451,457`, `instinct-builder.ts:205`, `volition.ts:385`, `agent.ts:267/408/524`, `cg-engine.ts:344`, `world.ts:536/578/1988`, `il.ts:626-627`, `topic-engine.ts:238-239`, `scheduler.ts:133-134`, `social/topic-sources.ts:664`, crime-justice index/step-handlers/investigation, `routes.ts`). The fallback chain makes the switch **byte-identical** until state axes are seeded.

## Open axes without breaking tsc-0
`registerTraitAxis(key,...)` is the open registry; the engine seeds OCEAN+H itself (universal psychometrics, INV-14-clean). The **closed `BigFive` interface stays** as the typed seed shape, so `keyof BigFive` typings keep compiling; module axes are reached only via the string-keyed `trait()` / CG `attr` path. `cg-engine.checkTrait` is already string-keyed and becomes the natural module-axis reader.

## The four engine knobs (law) vs module data (values)
TRIGGER (`when` incl. `abilityUse` = SPEC-2 seam) · MODE (`threshold | accumulation`) · MAGNITUDE (`step × magnitudeScale` from belief/sentiment) · REVERSIBILITY (`anneal` → drift; default irreversible). One module-agnostic evaluator runs in the EXISTING `registerTickPhaseHandler` loop (bilateral, event-aware — `event-registry.ts:670-700`). Plastic writes go through the EXISTING `adjustAttributeBase` (`world.ts:674`).

## The three seams (all thin wrappers, INV-14 preserved)
- **SPEC-2 ability-use** → `when.abilityUse` matches a use-event SPEC 2 emits; no coupling code.
- **Beliefs** → `selfBeliefConfidence` wraps `getMaxConfidenceFor(self,...)` (`beliefs.ts:82`); matcher is module-supplied; optional `emitBelief` writes via `addBelief` with a module-distinct source.
- **Relationships** → `sentimentTo` wraps `getRelationship(id).sentiment` (`relationships.ts:64`), RAW (not the crime-tuned `sentimentCurve`).
- **Enneagram** is NOT a seam: it is elastic prose keyed off live mood (`personality-prose.ts:46`); plasticity composes with it only indirectly (a plastic baseMood/stability shift changes which Enneagram band mood falls into). No double-counting, no code change.

## INV proofs
- **INV-06**: traits inherit the single-writer rule — effective is derived, never stored; elastic via `addTraitModifier`, plastic via `applyPlasticShift`→`adjustAttributeBase`. Mood machinery untouched.
- **INV-14**: only `trait:`/`pp:` prefixes and `threshold`/`accumulation` enter the engine — universal terms; the words Negation/trauma/wound/debt never appear. Triggers, matchers, self-id semantics, axis names beyond OCEAN+H are all module-supplied.
- **INV-16**: the PP evaluator iterates `ctx.agents` including the player; the player is fresh-seeded with `trait:` axes — player has plasticity and is a valid source/target. No NPC-only filter added.
- **INV-21**: old saves lack `trait:`/`pp:` keys → `trait()` falls back to the profile seed → no zeroing; empty agents stay clean via the existing omit-when-empty pattern.

## Migration ordering trap (resolved)
`trait-randomizer.ts:67` mutates `profile.bigFive` every boot. Keep it writing the seed unchanged; seed state axes FROM the seed only on FRESH boot (the attributes/factions XOR-boot pattern at `index.ts:728`); on LOADED boot, `loadState` restores axes and the seeder is skipped — so saved plastic shifts survive re-randomization.

## Phasing (additive before destructive)
P0 accessor + read-site switch (behavior-identical) → P1 state-back axes on fresh boot → P2 PlasticityRule + evaluator + World API (no rules = no change) → P3 belief/sentiment seams → P4 SPEC-2 ability-use seam. **No destructive step**: `profile.bigFive` and the `BigFive` interface are never removed (the naive "delete bigFive from profile" step is consciously rejected — keeping the seed is what makes the migration reversible and INV-21-trivial).

## Quality bar
tsc 0 after every phase (closed typings preserved); `bun test` green; crime + economy oracle unchanged through P0/P1 (zero rules registered); new `tests/plasticity.test.ts` uses a neutral synthetic domain with `clearPlasticityRules` hygiene mirroring `clearScoringContributors`.
